route_title: Asymmetric HfO2/SiO2 20-layer stack with perturbed inner layers
compilation_rationale: Fixed 20-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica initialized from baseline thicknesses with ±6 nm perturbation on layers 6–14. Optimization bounds are ±15 nm per layer. Three-band transmittance objectives are scored via mean aggregation. Gradient-based solver respects all geometric and material constraints without inventing results.
